user.title: Add a VIWACO water meter
user.description: Log in to tracuu.viwaco.vn and complete the CAPTCHA. From Network > Invoice.aspx > Request Headers, paste the full real Cookie value (or the Cookie: line). Do not use example cookies. Each customer code needs its own session.

reconfigure.title: Update VIWACO session
reconfigure.description: Update the session Cookie for this customer. The customer code and entity history remain unchanged.

reauth_confirm.title: VIWACO session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Log in again in your browser and copy the new Cookie request header.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot load invoice and meter pages
error.invalid_customer_id: The customer code must contain digits only
error.invalid_cookie_format: Cookie format invalid. Copy Request Headers > Cookie (not Set-Cookie).
error.session_expired: Session expired or not logged in. Get a fresh Cookie after login.
error.wrong_customer: This Cookie belongs to a different customer code.

init.title: VIWACO meter settings
init.description: Change name, poll interval and history range. Move the slider to the far right ({max_months} months) to select ALL VIWACO history, including future months. Range is anchored to latest VIWACO period; existing PDF/PNG files are not deleted. Use Reconfigure to update the Cookie. Session keep-alive checks only the invoice page every 15 minutes by default; effectiveness depends on VIWACO session policy.

data.auto_archive_enabled: Archive invoices only on actual billing changes

data_description.history_months: Minimum 6 months. Limits dashboard data and future invoice archives for this meter only.
data_description.auto_archive_enabled: First successful poll saves a baseline; later new bills or actual payment/invoice changes can trigger an archive. Unchanged polls never re-download. Files under /www are publicly accessible via /local/.
data_description.auto_archive_mode: Choose PDF, PNG or both for changed invoices.
